title: 730. Count Different Palindromic Subsequences

examples.explanation: The 6 different non-empty palindromic subsequences are 'b', 'c', 'bb', 'cc', 'bcb', 'bccb'. Note that 'bcb' is counted only once, even though it occurs twice.
There are 3104860382 different non-empty palindromic subsequences, which is 104860361 modulo 109 + 7.
